page.overview:
What is Skyrim?

Skyrim, also known as the Old Kingdom, Throat of the World, the Fatherland or Mereth by the first Nordic inhabitants, is a vast region set in the northern part of Tamriel — part of The Elder Scrolls.

It is the home of the Nords, large and hardy men and women who have a strong resistance to frost, both natural and magical.

Skyrim was originally inhabited by a race of Mer known as the Snow Elves, though after the Nordic-Falmer War, the Snow Elves were mostly destroyed and the Atmorans settled the land.

It is bordered by Morrowind to the east, Cyrodiil to the south, Hammerfell to the southwest, and High Rock to the west.

Also known as: Province of Skyrim, Old Kingdom.
